question: What result would acupuncture offer with a 500 Hz tuning fork, in an idiopathic right ear deafness?

options.opa: Rinne positive (+) of the right ear and Weber to the left ear.
options.opb: Rinne negative (-) of the right ear and Weber towards the left ear.
options.opc: Rinne positive (+) of the left ear and Weber to the right ear.
options.opd: Rinne negative (-) of the left ear and Weber to the right ear.
